title: A Dy10 Cluster Incorporates Two Sets of Vertex-Sharing Dy3 Triangles

material_class.structural_family: Dy10 cluster of four fused μ3-OH-capped Dy3 triangles / two vertex-sharing Dy5 subcores

synthesis.procedure: A methanolic solution (10 mL) of dysprosium acetate monohydrate (0.40 mmol, 143 mg) was added to the H4L ligand (0.40 mmol, 101 mg) in acetonitrile (40 mL). The resulting yellow solution was left unperturbed to evaporate slowly at room temperature. Yellow crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction were obtained after three weeks.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: slow evaporation of a methanol/acetonitrile solution
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: unperturbed slow evaporation; yellow crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction obtained after three weeks

properties.summary: Dc susceptibility (1000 Oe) shows χMT = 130.8 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K, below the 141.7 cm3 K mol−1 value expected for ten uncoupled DyIII ions, decreasing to 85.3 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K, attributed to Dy···Dy exchange and depopulation of Stark sublevels. M vs H/T plots below 7 K are non-superimposable; magnetization reaches 55.6 μB at 1.9 K and 7 T without saturation (below 100 μB for ten DyIII). Zero-dc-field ac susceptibility (3.0 G, 1–1400 Hz) shows frequency-dependent in-phase and out-of-phase signals above 1.9 K, indicating onset of slow magnetization relaxation, but no hysteresis on a conventional SQUID; potential SMM behaviour was noted as needing micro-SQUID confirmation.

measurements.name: ac susceptibility (onset of slow relaxation)
measurements.value: frequency-dependent χ' increase and χ'' signal; no M vs H hysteresis on conventional SQUID
measurements.conditions: 3.0 G ac field, 1–1400 Hz, zero dc field; signals above 1.9 K; T range 1.9–300 K on MPMS XL-7
